shift.title: Expertise is no longer enough. It has to become software.
shift.body: Every organization is full of know-how. But that knowledge stays trapped in spreadsheets, manual processes, and the minds of a few experts. Beyond Expertise turns that expertise into intelligent, automated, AI-augmented software — making it scalable, measurable, and durable.
shift.point1Body: We codify your best operational practices into robust, scalable products.
shift.point2Body: Every product embeds generative AI and automation at the core of the experience.
shift.point3Body: Your data stays yours. European hosting, native compliance.

products.title: A suite of AI-native software
products.subtitle: Eleven products published by Beyond Expertise, spanning every domain and designed to work together or on their own.

items.name: Nova
items.description: An enterprise AI assistant grounded securely in your internal data: writing, research, synthesis, and autonomous agents.
items.overview: Nova plugs securely into your internal knowledge — documents, databases, and business tools — so teams can draft, research, summarize, and automate with autonomous agents. Every answer stays grounded in your data, permission-aware, and fully auditable.

items.name: Atlas
items.description: A decision-intelligence platform that unifies your data sources and surfaces predictive insights in real time.
items.overview: Atlas unifies your scattered data sources into a single decision-intelligence layer with real-time dashboards, predictive models, and smart alerting. Turn raw data into decisions you can act on in seconds, without a data-engineering bottleneck.

items.name: Orchestra
items.description: Orchestrate your business processes end to end with visual workflows and AI agents that act on your behalf.
items.overview: Orchestra automates business processes end to end, combining visual no-code workflows with autonomous AI agents that execute across 200+ systems. Remove repetitive work and run complex operations with full visibility and control.

items.name: Vault
items.description: Unified governance, security, and compliance to control AI and data usage across the entire enterprise.
items.overview: Vault is the governance, security, and compliance layer for AI and data across your enterprise. Enforce policies, demonstrate EU AI Act and GDPR compliance, and keep an immutable audit trail over every model, dataset, and access.

items.name: Flux
items.description: AI-driven supply chain planning that forecasts demand, optimizes inventory, and orchestrates warehouse and transport flows end to end.
items.overview: Flux brings AI to your entire supply chain — forecasting demand, optimizing inventory, and orchestrating warehouse and transport flows. Plan with confidence, absorb disruptions in real time, and cut stockouts and overstock at the same time.

items.name: Ledger
items.description: Real-time fraud detection, AML/KYC, and risk intelligence that keep financial operations compliant and secure at scale.
items.overview: Ledger protects financial operations with real-time fraud detection, automated AML/KYC, and continuous risk intelligence. Stay ahead of evolving regulation while stopping fraud before it settles.

items.name: Pulse
items.description: Clinical decision support and document intelligence that turn medical data into safer, faster, privacy-first care.
items.overview: Pulse augments clinical and operational teams with decision support and document intelligence, turning records, claims, and imaging into faster, safer care. Data sovereignty and patient privacy are built in by design.

items.name: Forge
items.description: Predictive maintenance, computer-vision quality control, and real-time performance management for connected factories.
items.overview: Forge connects the factory floor to predict failures before they happen, inspect quality with computer vision, and manage performance in real time. Maximize OEE and move toward zero unplanned downtime.

items.name: Prism
items.description: A personalization and merchandising engine that tailors every experience, optimizes pricing, and balances stock in real time.
items.overview: Prism personalizes every customer touchpoint and optimizes merchandising in real time. Recommendation, dynamic pricing, and inventory intelligence work together to lift conversion, basket size, and margin.

items.name: Helix
items.description: Unified HR, payroll, and skills intelligence to plan, develop, and retain talent across the entire organization.
items.overview: Helix unifies HR, payroll, and skills intelligence into one workforce platform. Plan headcount, develop talent, and anticipate attrition with data — so people decisions are as rigorous as financial ones.

items.name: Scorify
items.description: An AI hiring platform that turns 40 hours of CV screening into 10 minutes: upload CVs in bulk, score and rank candidates against your criteria, and generate tailored interview questions.
items.overview: Scorify is an AI-powered hiring platform for lean teams. Upload CVs in bulk, let AI score and rank every applicant against your job criteria in seconds, auto-generate interview questions, and collaborate — smart hiring with zero spreadsheets.
